rows.my_view: Base $130 with mispriced upside, bull to $186.
rows.committee: Fair at $109.89 with ~18% to base, but the bull $186 leans on platform optionality that has produced only rejections.

rows.my_view: Durable compounder with platform adding future growth.
rows.committee: Revenue is flat (+1% YoY off a +38% CAGR); any per-share growth comes from buybacks, not revenue.
FY2025 operating margin fell 30%→20%, but Q1 bounced to 22%; the trough may have passed, but the cause is undisclosed and unproven.

rows.my_view: A real cash engine that could fund a broader radiopharma platform.
rows.committee: The fresh-dose logistics network is a genuine but narrow moat around a single product with zero switching costs, and the platform extension is unproven.
The ~9% share reduction in 18 months on 0.3x leverage is genuinely disciplined and is the load-bearing beam of the base case.
Zero switching costs mean the flat +1% quarter is the moat being tested in real time, and it is visible now but unresolved.

rows.my_view: Self-named FOMO and attraction to muddy setups.
rows.committee: The segment mix (PYLARIFY's revenue share) is absent from every source, so the entire concentration question cannot be closed today, and you are emotionally anchored to a platform story that only produced FDA rejections.

rows.my_view: Platform optionality converting to a named second product.
rows.committee: The July 30 print: PYLARIFY volume trend and whether operating margin holds ≥22% will resolve durability in one identifiable event.

confidence.label: Moderate
confidence.why: The two thesis-gating facts—PYLARIFY's revenue share and the cause of the FY2025 margin dip—are absent from all sources, so the durability question stays genuinely open until July 30.

final_verdict: The thesis narrows from hidden platform to hidden per-share compounder and survives as an evidence-gated watchlist that must not convert on price.
